title: 9 Signs a Godly Man Is Still Two Different Guys
caption:
Church version. Gym version. Group chat version. Same guy, or none of them are real.

A man's real faith isn't measured by what he does when everyone's watching. It's measured by whether the private tab, the group chat, and the Sunday version match up.

What's the gap between your loudest version and your most honest one? That's the work.

#faith #integrity #godlyman #christianmen #authenticity
